evidence.t: 55 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 0.9 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 60 m SE: browse.

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 133 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.45677, -124.75721, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 68 m, about 110 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 90 m S of the spot at 1,203 m (55.48379, -124.82247). Water: Klawli River 40 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-28, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
